scope: Append-only numerical-substrate compatibility replay of unchanged prior candidates; no optimization, exclusions, pool replacement, grading, domain or tolerance changes

substrates.canonical: Exact authenticated ref_signal values at the unchanged selected rows; these are the phase1 numerical substrate, not new biological truth
substrates.reconstructed: Exact authenticated phase2 selected_source.npz smoothed values; preserve their separate strict-domain classifications
substrates.authority: Pinned phase2 receipts independently checked selected raw/smoothed data and source gradient ordering. This replay does not read raw acquisition files, rerun smoothing or newly certify physical gradient orientation
substrates.normalization: Each substrate uses its own measured smoothed b0 in the unchanged MSE and S0 ratio definitions

arithmetic.implementation: Reuse pinned phase2 prediction_and_metrics for both substrates to isolate only the input representation; not a third independent forward implementation
arithmetic.domain: Exact unchanged domain from pinned prior_contract; strict S0/f bounds and relative-capped eigenvalue allowance
arithmetic.comparisons: Exact feasibility equality; unchanged phase2 MSE/FA comparison tolerances; no new epsilon, parameter clipping or repairs

completion_rule: All canonical candidate classifications and available prior metrics match, reconstructed metrics/classifications reproduce phase2, exact support retained. Substrate membership differences remain reported; no scientific release is inferred
release_boundary: Replay completion is numerical compatibility evidence only. Phase2 status and every prior pool/score remain immutable. Model adequacy, discrepancy justification, search quality, biological identifiability and LLM hardness remain unqualified. The separate adequacy/search proposal is not authorized by this replay approval
